app.title: Drawgent: Coding agent on a live Excalidraw canvas
app.author: parasitid
app.description: Web-based coding agent that interacts with an Excalidraw canvas, enabling real‑time drawing and code generation.

proposed_tests.test: Verify web UI loads and connects to canvas
Run a sample code generation command via API and confirm canvas updates
Measure latency of code generation for 100 characters
Check that the tool can be installed via npm and run locally
Test undo/redo functionality in the canvas after code insertion
